newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends mixed, liquidation seen in July.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends mixed, liquidation seen in July.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended mixed Tuesday, with July under pressure from liquidation before first notice day on Monday, traders said.
"This whole week has been marked by liquidation in July and positions being moved forward," said one pit trader.
Deferred contracts remained underpinned by uncertainty over the development of the U.S. rice crop, traders said.
"We're dealing with a shaky U.S. crop," a trader said.
Cool weather this April and May has thinned out rice stands and left the crop more vulnerable to weeds and water weevils, one floor trader said.
Advances in new crop months were limited by reports of overnight monsoonal rains in India, pit traders said.
LIT was a noted buyer in July, and traders said that commercials largely owned the open positions remaining in that contract.
Volume was estimated at 400 contracts, which is below Monday's actual volume of 770 contracts.
Rice closed three cents per cwt lower to five higher, with July down three at $11.54 per cwt.
